metadata.description: Cute and useful Claude Code mods: a pet, live panes, a boss fight, chimes and a model router

plugins.name: cute-feed
plugins.description: A pet that hatches, grows and reacts to what Claude does, over a live emoji feed

plugins.name: dashboard
plugins.description: Live pane: project, git, session usage, subagents and recent activity

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: Live tree of the session's subagents: who spawned whom and what each is doing

plugins.name: repo-radar
plugins.description: Map of the repo that lights up as files are read, edited or fail

plugins.name: boss-fight
plugins.description: Failing lint, tests or typechecks spawn a boss above the prompt; each fix damages it

plugins.name: chime
plugins.description: Chimes and notifies when a long turn finishes or Claude waits on you

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Routes prompts and subagents to a cheaper or stronger model by what they ask
